description: Profile every column of a CSV: inferred type (number, integer, date, email or text), non-empty and missing counts, distinct values, and min/max for numeric columns. Choose this for a per-column picture of a CSV: inferred type, non-empty and missing counts, distinct values, and min/max for numeric columns. Do not choose this when you want the file diagnosed for import errors (use csv-preflight) or a completeness report (use csv-missing-value-report). Example requests: Profile the columns of this CSV before I load it. | Profile which CSV column is numeric and what is its range? | How many distinct values are in each CSV column? Profile this file.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

content.description: The customer's input.csv, as text. Supported: CSV, TSV or any delimiter-separated text. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
